description: Create, update and delete Action Groups.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: append_tags
parameters.description: Use to control if tags field is canonical or just appends to existing tags. When canonical, any tags not found in the tags parameter will be removed from the object’s metadata. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: arm_role_receivers
parameters.description: The list of ARM role receivers that are part of this action group. Roles are Azure RBAC roles and only built-in roles are supported. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/azure-mgmt-monitor/azure.mgmt.monitor.v2023_01_01.models.armrolereceiver?view=azure-python

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name this receiver. Names must be unique across all receivers within an action group. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: role_id
parameters.description: The arm role id. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: use_common_alert_schema
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use common alert schema. Defaults to False when not set (server side default). Choices: false true

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: automation_runbook_receivers
parameters.description: The list of AutomationRunbook receivers that are part of this action group. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/azure-mgmt-monitor/azure.mgmt.monitor.v2023_01_01.models.automationrunbookreceiver?view=azure-python

parameters.name: automation_account_id
parameters.description: The Azure automation account Id which holds this runbook and authenticate to Azure resource. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: is_global_runbook
parameters.description: Indicates whether this instance is global runbook. Choices: false true

parameters.name: runbook_name
parameters.description: The name for this runbook. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: service_uri
parameters.description: The URI where webhooks should be sent.

parameters.name: webhook_resource_id
parameters.description: The resource id for webhook linked to this runbook. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: azure_app_push_receivers
parameters.description: The list of AzureAppPush receivers that are part of this action group. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/azure-mgmt-monitor/azure.mgmt.monitor.v2023_01_01.models.azureapppushreceiver?view=azure-python

parameters.name: email_address
parameters.description: The email address registered for the Azure mobile app. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: azure_function_receivers
parameters.description: The list of azure function receivers that are part of this action group. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/azure-mgmt-monitor/azure.mgmt.monitor.v2023_01_01.models.azurefunctionreceiver?view=azure-python

parameters.name: function_app_resource_id
parameters.description: The azure resource id of the function app. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: function_name
parameters.description: The function name in the function app. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: http_trigger_url
parameters.description: The http trigger url where http request sent to. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: email_receivers
parameters.description: The list of email receivers that are part of this action group. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/azure-mgmt-monitor/azure.mgmt.monitor.v2023_01_01.models.emailreceiver?view=azure-python

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Indicates whether this action group is enabled. If an action group is not enabled, then none of its receivers will receive communications. Choices: false true

parameters.name: event_hub_receivers
parameters.description: The list of event hub receivers that are part of this action group. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/azure-mgmt-monitor/azure.mgmt.monitor.v2023_01_01.models.eventhubreceiver?view=azure-python

parameters.name: event_hub_name
parameters.description: The name of the specific Event Hub queue. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: event_hub_name_space
parameters.description: The Event Hub namespace. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: The Id for the subscription containing this event hub. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: The tenant Id for the subscription containing this event hub.

parameters.name: group_short_name
parameters.description: The short name of the action group. This will be used in SMS messages.

parameters.name: itsm_receivers
parameters.description: The list of webhook receivers that are part of this action group. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/azure-mgmt-monitor/azure.mgmt.monitor.v2023_01_01.models.itsmreceiver?view=azure-python

parameters.name: connection_id
parameters.description: Unique identification of ITSM connection among multiple defined in above workspace. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region in which workspace resides. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: ticket_configuration
parameters.description: JSON blob for the configurations of the ITSM action. CreateMultipleWorkItems option will be part of this blob as well. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: OMS LA instance identifier. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Location of the action group. defaults to location of exiting action group or location of the resource group if unspecified. Action groups are usually ‘Global’.

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: logic_app_receivers
parameters.description: The list of logic app receivers that are part of this action group. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/azure-mgmt-monitor/azure.mgmt.monitor.v2023_01_01.models.logicappreceiver?view=azure-python

parameters.name: callback_url
parameters.description: The callback url where http request sent to. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: The azure resource id of the logic app receiver. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: The name of the resource group.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: sms_receivers
parameters.description: The list of SMS receivers that are part of this action group. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/azure-mgmt-monitor/azure.mgmt.monitor.v2023_01_01.models.smsreceiver?view=azure-python

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: The country code of the SMS receiver. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: phone_number
parameters.description: The phone number of the SMS receiver. Required when setting this receiver.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the action group. Use present for creating/updating a action group. Use absent for deleting a action group. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Dictionary of string:string pairs to assign as metadata to the object. Metadata tags on the object will be updated with any provided values. To remove tags set append_tags option to false. Currently, Azure DNS zones and Traffic Manager services also don’t allow the use of spaces in the tag. Azure Front Door doesn’t support the use of Azure Automation and Azure CDN only support 15 tags on resources.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: voice_receivers
parameters.description: The list of voice receivers that are part of this action group. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/azure-mgmt-monitor/azure.mgmt.monitor.v2023_01_01.models.voicereceiver?view=azure-python

parameters.name: webhook_receivers
parameters.description: The list of webhook receivers that are part of this action group. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/azure-mgmt-monitor/azure.mgmt.monitor.v2023_01_01.models.webhookreceiver?view=azure-python

parameters.name: identifier_uri
parameters.description: Indicates the identifier uri for aad auth.

parameters.name: object_id
parameters.description: Indicates the webhook app object Id for aad auth.

parameters.name: use_aad_auth
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not use AAD authentication. Defaults to False when not set (server side default). Choices: false true

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Add a action group
  azure.azcollection.azure_rm_monitoractiongroups:
    state: present
    name: action_group_name
    resource_group: resource_group_name
    enabled: true
    location: Global
    email_receivers:
      - email_address: xxx@hostname.tld
        name: sendmail
        use_common_alert_schema: true
    group_short_name: short_name
    append_tags: false
    tags:
      ThisIsAnExampleTag: ExampleValue

- name: Add tag to existing action group
  azure.azcollection.azure_rm_monitoractiongroups:
    state: present
    name: action_group_name
    resource_group: resource_group_name
    append_tags: true
    tags:
      ThisIsAnAddedExampleTag: ExampleValue

- name: Remove all tags on existing action group
  azure.azcollection.azure_rm_monitoractiongroups:
    state: present
    name: action_group_name
    resource_group: resource_group_name
    append_tags: false

- name: Delete a action group
  azure.azcollection.azure_rm_monitoractiongroups:
    state: absent
    name: action_group_name
    resource_group: resource_group_name

return_values.name: actiongroup
return_values.description: Details of the action group Is null on state==absent (action group does not exist or will be deleted) Assumes you make legal changes in check mode Returned: always Sample: {"arm_role_receivers": [], "automation_runbook_receivers": [], "azure_app_push_receivers": [], "azure_function_receivers": [], "email_receivers": [{"email_address": "xxx@hostname.tld", "name": "sendmail", "use_common_alert_schema": true}], "enabled": true, "event_hub_receivers": [], "group_short_name": "shortname", "id": "/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/resougce_group_name/providers/microsoft.insights/actionGroups/action_group_name", "itsm_receivers": [], "location": "Global", "logic_app_receivers": [], "name": "action_group_name", "sms_receivers": [], "tags": {}, "type": "Microsoft.Insights/ActionGroups", "voice_receivers": [], "webhook_receivers": []}
